en: Solid gallium melts at 29.76 degrees Celsius, meaning a piece of it will turn into a liquid puddle just from the heat of your bare hand.
When iron rusts, it chemically combines with oxygen from the air, causing the resulting rusty object to actually weigh more than the original solid iron.
Liquid mercury is a metal so incredibly dense at room temperature that a heavy steel bowling ball will actually float on its surface.
Both the hardest natural material, diamond, and the softest pencil lead, graphite, are made of the exact same pure carbon atoms arranged differently.
Dry ice is solid carbon dioxide that undergoes sublimation, turning directly into a cold fog gas without ever melting into a liquid first.
Unlike most substances, water expands in volume by about nine percent when it freezes into solid ice, making ice less dense than liquid water.
The Sun is not a solid, liquid, or gas, but is made of plasma, a superheated state of matter where electrons separate from atoms.
Mayonnaise is a stable emulsion where egg yolk acts as an emulsifier to permanently mix liquid oil and liquid vinegar, which normally repel each other.
Water strider insects can walk across a pond without sinking because water molecules stick tightly together at the surface, creating strong surface tension.
Adding salt to ice lowers its freezing point, causing solid ice to melt into liquid water even when the surrounding air temperature is below zero.
Aerogel is a synthetic solid material composed of 99.8 percent air, yet it is strong enough to support thousands of times its own weight.
Mixing baking soda and vinegar triggers a chemical reaction that rapidly produces carbon dioxide gas, the exact same invisible gas humans exhale when breathing.
